verdict.rationale: Browser-based session access is a fair question for a remote-desktop product like AnyDesk, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only installed clients (CLI, Customer/Service Module EXEs) and a REST API for account data. Nothing shows a session can be viewed or controlled from a plain browser with no install.

support.subject: As a power user, someone can view or control a session from a plain browser with nothing installed
